name: Dr. Maren Voss
background: Designed the Argus-7 over six years. Brilliant, guarded, and famously protective of her work. Holds a share of the patent.
motive: The board has quietly agreed to sell Halden. Voss has said she would rather see the Argus-7 destroyed than handed to a competitor.
opportunity: Authorised for Storage Room B and knew the prototype's routine better than anyone.
personality: Precise, proud, short-tempered. Answers questions with questions.

relationships.note: Supervises Alex. Trusts his calibration work.
Openly at odds with Lang over the sale.

name: Alex Reyes
background: Joined Halden four years ago. Reliable, quiet, always first to volunteer for late calibration shifts. Holds a Level 3 card with Storage Room B access.
motive: Recently behind on a personal loan. Colleagues have noticed him checking his watch and taking calls in the stairwell.
opportunity: Level 3 card opens Storage Room B. Knows the camera and lock systems from years of lab maintenance.
personality: Polite, helpful, unremarkable. Nobody has a bad word to say about him.

relationships.note: Occasionally files maintenance requests that Cho carries out.

name: Victor Lang
background: Built Halden from a garage workshop into a 400-person firm. Sharp, charming, and heavily in debt to the bank that funds the expansion.
motive: Is negotiating a confidential sale of the company to Kessler-Ward Corp. He needs the Argus-7 demonstrated on Monday to close the deal.
opportunity: Master card opens every door in the building.
personality: Smooth, evasive, prone to speeches. Never answers a question directly.

relationships.note: Voss opposes his plan to sell.

name: Nina Okafor
background: Ex-police dispatcher. Eight years on the night desk. By the book, and proud of a clean record.
motive: None obvious. A single mother with a sick child and a mortgage.
opportunity: Controls the lobby desk. If anything moves through the building at night, she should see it.
personality: Calm, watchful, tired. Speaks in short, factual sentences.
accessLevel: Level 2 (lobby, corridors, master keys in desk safe)

name: Daniel Cho
background: Keeps the switchboard, modems and CCTV recorders running. Works from home when he can. Talks in acronyms.
motive: Passed over for promotion twice. Holds a grudge against management.
opportunity: Can pause or reset the CCTV recorders remotely, and knows exactly how.

relationships.note: Carries out Alex's maintenance work orders.
